reviews.title: Gives you a report, but that’s it.
reviews.text: I ran a report to find who I was following that were not following me back.  It said I had close to 1k fluff accounts (as I call them).  The report then gives you an unfollow button next to their account name, but from the very first account I tried to unfollow, I received a message saying “Something went wrong- Instagram limit reached.  Try again later”.  I get up the next morning, same story.  So I’m not going to pay the “Pro” feature price if an app only does half of what it says it will do.  If you want to do a one time report to cut the fluff, pay the $.50 fee for the week’s trial run, run your report, and then immediately turn around and cancel your membership before they charge you the jacked up weekly amount they switch you to a week later.

reviews.title: Waste of money ☹️
reviews.text: I don’t like complaining… but this is definitely a waste of money. All of the analytics are what you can already access FOR FREE through instagram itself. It only shows you the amount of views your profile has had, who you’ve blocked, who you follow, and who follows you. The only partially interesting things were seeing who recently viewed your profile… but that still isn’t really worth the money - and I’m not quite sure if it was 100% accurate either, as it didn’t pick up my friends account or my second one. The only other thing was being able to “secretly view” story’s - I believe this is a payed feature though, and again maybe only worked 50% of the time. An app like this should be free - after all it is our data.

reviews.title: Scam or App Not Functioning After Payment
reviews.text:
I purchased a one-year subscription for your app, but it’s not working properly at all.
The app doesn’t show any data — it doesn’t display who unfollowed, blocked, or interacted, and basically nothing works as promised.
I have already paid for the full subscription, so I expect the service I paid for to function correctly.
Please fix this issue immediately or process a refund for my payment.
It’s really disappointing to pay for a premium plan and receive no service in return.
Looking forward to your quick response and solution.

Thank you.
